FolderLink lets ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI apps read the project folders you choose, straight from your laptop. Read-only, logged, and revocable in one click.

This is the first beta. The archives do not include a version in the filename, so the download links in the README keep working.

## Install

macOS Apple silicon:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_darwin_arm64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

macOS Intel:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_darwin_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

Linux x86_64:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_linux_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

Linux arm64:

```bash
curl -L -o folderlink.tar.gz https://github.com/mmuizahmed/mcp-bridge/releases/latest/download/folderlink_linux_arm64.tar.gz
tar -xzf folderlink.tar.gz
```

Windows: download `folderlink_windows_amd64.zip` and unzip it.

Then:

```bash
folderlink allow ~/projects/my-app --label my-app
folderlink
```

Pair the laptop at https://folderlink.muiz.pk/pair and add the connector at https://folderlink.muiz.pk/mcp.

## In this beta

- A small static binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Pairing, an allowlist enforced on the laptop, and read-only `list_files` and `read_file`.
- Secret files such as `.env` and keys are blocked.

## Known limits

- OAuth for the ChatGPT connector is not wired yet. Agents need a bearer token from the dashboard.
- The hosted service at folderlink.muiz.pk is not deployed yet. You can run the worker yourself. See docs/SELF-HOSTING.md.
- Release archives are not signed. Signing stays off until `COSIGN_YES` is set.
